purpose: pytest coverage for VT100Player rendering boundaries. It captures generated frame buffers, validates key escape sequences/timebar placement, verifies coordinate rejection, and asserts base draw_frame must be overridden.
invariants: _load_frame emits the clear-screen escape on first render, writes the frame at top_margin, and writes the timebar on the final row.
_move_cursor rejects x/y values outside the 1-based screen bounds.
gotchas: CapturingPlayer overrides draw_frame only for tests and stores raw bytes from the rewound buffer.
